policy: All active skills share one canonical root; origin/provenance is metadata. Load skills just-in-time and prefer capability-specific adaptations over large generic bundles.

skills.name: accessibility-game
skills.description: Game accessibility design/review. Use for readable UI, color/contrast, text scaling, remappable controls, reduced motion, sensory alternatives, captions/subtitles, timing tolerance, and accessible onboarding.

skills.name: agent-instruction-design
skills.description: Design and prune AGENTS.md files, role prompts, skills, and agent-facing documentation using context pointers, progressive disclosure, explicit completion criteria, and single-source-of-truth rules.

skills.name: asset-production
skills.description: Game asset production and sourcing. Use for art-direction-controlled sourcing, asset families, specifications, Poly Haven/Openverse/Creator Store search, Blender/glTF cleanup, provenance, licensing, import validation, and approval.

skills.name: assurance-two-axis
skills.description: Keep spec/scope fidelity separate from engineering/project-standard quality during independent review so polished wrong-scope code cannot mask a product miss and spec-correct code cannot hide unsafe implementation.

skills.name: audio-production
skills.description: Roblox SFX/audio production and integration with provenance, layering, spatial behavior, loudness hierarchy and live trigger validation.

skills.name: blender-game-asset
skills.description: Reference-driven Blender game-asset modeling pipeline from blockout through export/round-trip validation; optional approved Blender capability.

skills.name: blender-mcp-production
skills.description: Priority Blender MCP authoring workflow with target verification, measured modeling gates, Roblox-ready export and round-trip validation.

skills.name: blender-technical-art
skills.description: Blender technical-art workflow. Use when local Blender is available for topology cleanup, decimation, UV/material consolidation, pivot/scale correction, collision proxies, rig fixes, LODs, deterministic Python automation, or export validation.

skills.name: bloxmaps-ui-accelerator
skills.description: Optional BloxUI blueprint/prototype acceleration without forcing Fusion/runtime adoption or a model vendor.

skills.name: bloxmaps-world-production
skills.description: Deterministic BloxMaps world/layout generation, asset-manifest bridge, Studio build verification and review.

skills.name: building-3d-objects
skills.description: Roblox-native 3D object building via Studio MCP. Use for props, structures, room-scale models, modular sets, CSG/Parts construction, spatial planning, and post-build validation.

skills.name: building-maps
skills.description: Roblox map/world building via Studio MCP. Use for lobbies, arenas, levels, multi-zone environments, terrain/module layout, landmarks, lighting/atmosphere, and large-scale validation.

skills.name: codebase-design
skills.description: Design deep, testable Roblox/Luau modules with small interfaces and clean seams. Use when module shape, ownership, adapter boundaries, testability, or architectural locality is the real problem.

skills.name: complexity-risk-router
skills.description: Classify Roblox work into v8 LIGHT/STANDARD/CRITICAL gates and select proportional planning, Studio, testing and review requirements.

skills.name: context-checkpoint-manager
skills.description: Creates or repairs durable continuation checkpoints so a fresh agent/runtime session can resume from repository state after interruption, usage exhaustion, restart, or intentional rollover.

skills.name: context-memory-curator
skills.description: Just-in-time context, structured checkpoint capsules, stale-context pruning and durable repository memory for long-running agent work.

skills.name: decision-grilling
skills.description: Resolve consequential ambiguity with a dependency-aware decision frontier. Use when one material product, design, architecture, or workflow decision depends on other unresolved decisions; keep facts with the agent and decisions with the human.

skills.name: design-taste
skills.description: Roblox visual taste and anti-generic critique; controlled alternatives, reference transformation and evidence-honest design review.

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.description: Sharpen the game's shared language and durable domain concepts. Use when terms are overloaded, code/design vocabulary conflicts, or a hard-to-reverse surprising tradeoff needs a durable decision record.

skills.name: economy-progression
skills.description: Game economy and progression design. Use for currencies, faucets/sinks, upgrades, rarity, reward schedules, progression curves, monetization boundaries, inflation controls, and balance risk.

skills.name: external-questionnaire
skills.description: Create a focused questionnaire when a task is blocked by knowledge held by another stakeholder, artist, developer, vendor, tester, or domain expert. Use instead of asking the current user to guess information they do not possess.

skills.name: game-design-fundamentals
skills.description: Game-design analysis. Use for player fantasy, core/session/long-term loops, progression, rewards, economy, difficulty, onboarding, replayability, differentiation, MVP scope, and design tradeoffs.

skills.name: graphify-repo-intelligence
skills.description: Local-first Graphify repository graph usage for impact/topology/context discovery before broad scans or extra agents.

skills.name: human-decision-gates
skills.description: Human-in-the-loop gate policy for scope, art direction, installations/MCPs, paid services, licensing, destructive changes, migrations, Production and policy exceptions.

skills.name: impeccable-ui
skills.description: Roblox-adapted interface craft and critique guidance inspired by Impeccable/Anthropic frontend design; distinctive hierarchy, tokens, complete states and anti-generic polish.

skills.name: implementation-package-builder
skills.description: Builds deterministic implementation contracts for Roblox feature workers. Use before delegating Tier 2–4 implementation.

skills.name: interaction-motion
skills.description: Roblox-adapted interaction/motion guidance inspired by Emil Kowalski; tactile feedback, transitions, easing, interruptibility and reduced-motion review.

skills.name: mcp-tool-orchestration
skills.description: On-demand MCP/tool discovery, official-first routing, least privilege, install approval, efficient programmatic use and evidence rules.

skills.name: model-policy-governor
skills.description: Mandatory shared model/effort governance, exact-model runtime binding, local evidence validation and documented high-effort exceptions across Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and future runtimes.

skills.name: playable-vertical-slice
skills.description: Demand executable gameplay proof, integrated server/client loops and actual Studio acceptance scenarios before declaring a feature done; a Rojo build, stub code or mock UI alone does not count.

skills.name: polyhaven
skills.description: Poly Haven asset discovery and safe download planning. Use for free CC0 models, textures, HDRIs, taxonomy, metadata, file variants, and provenance through the Poly Haven public API.

skills.name: primary-source-research
skills.description: Investigate a task question using authoritative primary sources and leave a concise cited research note. Use when repository/tool evidence is insufficient and external facts materially affect a decision or implementation.

skills.name: process-inbox
skills.description: Convert a rough Roblox idea/update into streamlined issue-local task state while preserving the human request; retain legacy inbox compatibility.

skills.name: project-initializer
skills.description: Prepare or repair a v8 Roblox team checkout, shared skills and local developer runtime without forcing live Studio validation before idea capture.

skills.name: quality-gate
skills.description: Apply risk-proportional LIGHT/STANDARD/CRITICAL Definition-of-Done gates and independent review requirements.

skills.name: release-readiness-review
skills.description: Performs final independent readiness review before merge/tag/release. Use for substantial changesets and all release candidates.

skills.name: roblox-frontend-systems
skills.description: Roblox-native responsive GUI/HUD systems, device input, safe areas, states, performance and server trust boundaries while preserving approved visual depth.

skills.name: roblox-ui-polish
skills.description: Reference-driven Roblox GUI visual design, functional state bindings and device-tested live Studio UI iteration.

skills.name: skill-supply-chain-review
skills.description: Agent-skill supply-chain review. Use before installing/updating third-party skills to inspect SKILL.md, bundled scripts, package manifests, lifecycle hooks, network/process/file access, licenses, and prompt/tool-injection risk.

skills.name: skill-use-audit
skills.description: Verify that selected subagents loaded their specific skills and produced the required artifacts; do not treat skill names, execution claims or self-reviews as proof.

skills.name: studio-place-integration
skills.description: Mandatory correct-place Studio MCP + Rojo separate handshake and verified live edit/sync/playtest evidence.

skills.name: stylized-asset-families
skills.description: Art-directed CC0 stylized assets and consistent families with licensing, import and in-game visual verification.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Evidence-first Roblox debugging using the cheapest tight feedback loop; avoids mandatory TDD and escalates architecture after repeated failed fixes.

skills.name: team-workflow-orchestrator
skills.description: Run the streamlined v8 issue-scoped workflow: one Issue, one task branch, byte-preserved request, risk-proportional implementation, draft PR, human merge/release.

skills.name: ui-production
skills.description: Require a real UI screen and interaction map, approved mockup, stateful functional wiring, responsive device validation and screenshots before production UI can be accepted; never count an empty UI skeleton as done.

skills.name: vfx-production
skills.description: Roblox VFX production for readable layered particles/beams/trails/lights with gameplay intent, mobile budgets and real Studio validation.

skills.name: visual-design-orchestration
skills.description: Provider-neutral visual-design capability ladder and evidence/approval workflow.

skills.name: visual-production
skills.description: Require pre-approved game art direction, distinct reference/concept options, asset families, material/lighting/set-dressing pass, provenance and full-scale in-game camera screenshots before a visually significant feature may be marked finished. Blocks/grayboxes are explicitly stage-labeled, never passed off as final unless the signed art bible calls for them.

skills.name: workflow-retrospective
skills.description: Review a completed or troubled agent session for improvements to navigation, checks, instructions, tool economy, information access, and workflow guardrails. Use explicitly after meaningful failure/friction; do not run after every task.
